title: Annam
text: Annam evābhinandanti || ubhayo devamānusā || atha ko nāma so yakkho || yam annaṃ nābhinandatīti || || Ye naṃ dadanti saddhāya || vippasannena cetasā || tam eva annaṃ bhajati || asmiṃ loke paramhi ca || || Tasmā vineyya maccheraṃ || dajjā dānaṃ malābhibhū || puññāni paralokasmiṃ || patiṭṭhā honti pāṇinan ti || ||
